You have a routine dental checkup with Dr. Sean O'Connor on Friday, October 30th at 9:00 AM for sixty-five euro. 

If you have any questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you very much for your help! I appreciate it. Goodbye!
